entities.summary:
Justin was a Latin writer and historian who lived under the Roman Empire.

Born in the 1st century AD, Justin was a prolific writer and scholar who produced works on history, philosophy, and theology.

His most famous work, the Epitome of the Philippics, is a history of the Roman Empire from the 3rd century BC to the 1st century AD.

Justin's writings played a significant role in shaping the Christian understanding of the Old Testament and its relationship to the New Testament.

Despite the passage of time, Justin's work remains an important source for understanding the early Christian period and its connections to the broader ancient Roman world.

The ruins of Justin's tomb in Nicopolis, Greece, hold the remains of this enigmatic figure, a testament to his enduring legacy in the realm of historical scholarship.
